(NOT APPROVED)

  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  AUGUST 8, 2017

A regular meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Pro Tem Davis at 5:33
p.m., on Tuesday, August 8, 2017, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Pro Tem Gleam Davis
  Councilmember Sue Himmelrich
  Councilmember Kevin McKeown
  Councilmember Terry O’Day
  Councilmember Tony Vazquez

  Absent:  Mayor Ted Winterer
  Councilmember Pam O’Connor

  Also Present:  City Manager Rick Cole
  Interim City Attorney Joseph Lawrence
  City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor Pro Tem, the City Council convened at 5:33 p.m.,
  with all members present except Mayor Winterer and Councilmember
  O’Connor. Interim Assistant City Attorney Alan Seltzer led the
  assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

CLOSED SESSIONS  Members of the public Eoin Gubbins and Sherry Frumkin commented on
  closed sessions.

  On order of the Mayor Pro Tem, the City Council recessed at 5:40 p.m., to
  consider closed sessions and returned at 7:17 p.m., with all members
  present except Mayor Winterer and Councilmember O’Connor absent, to
  report the following:

  1.A. Real Property Negotiations: for property located at 3026
  Airport Avenue

  City Negotiators: Nelson Hernandez  and  Stelios  Makrides
  Under Negotiation: lease term and price

  The Interim City Attorney advised this matter was heard, with no
  reportable action taken.

  1  August 8, 2017
 1.B. Conference with Legal Counsel – Existing Litigation –
Litigation has been initiated formally pursuant to Government Code
Section 54956.9(d)(1): Vahebi v. City of Santa Monica, et al., Los
Angeles Superior Court Case Number BC 565 118

The Interim City Attorney advised this matter was a fall on a city sidewalk
on Arizona that resulted in injuries, and recommended a settlement in the
amount of $70,000.

Motion by Councilmember McKeown, seconded by Councilmember
O’Day, to approve Settlement Agreement No. 10527 (CCS) in the amount
of $70,000. The motion was approved by the following vote:

AYES:  Councilmembers O’Day, Himmelrich, Vazquez, McKeown
  Mayor Pro Tem Davis
NOES:  None
ABSENT: Councilmember O’Connor, Mayor Winterer

1.C. Conference with Legal Counsel – Existing Litigation –
Litigation has been initiated formally pursuant to Government Code
Section 54956.9(d)(1): Vargas Arguenta v. City of Santa Monica, Los
Angeles Superior Court Case Number BC 613 269

The Interim City Attorney advised this matter was a vehicle accident with
injuries to a husband and wife, and recommended a settlement in the
amount of $95,000 ($75,000 for Brenda and $20,000 for Jonathan).

Motion by Councilmember Vazquez, seconded by Councilmember
Himmelrich, to approve Settlement Agreement No. 10528 (CCS), in the
amount of $95,000. The motion was approved by the following vote:

AYES:  Councilmembers McKeown, Vazquez, Himmelrich, O’Day
  Mayor Pro Tem Davis
NOES:  None
ABSENT: Mayor Winterer, Councilmember O’Connor

1.D. Conference with Legal Counsel – Existing Litigation –
Litigation has been initiated formally pursuant to Government Code
Section 54956.9(d)(1): Alcorta (Ushuaia Restaurant), et al. v. City of
Santa Monica, Los Angeles Superior Court Case Number BC 608 510

The Interim City Attorney advised this matter was a city trash truck ran
into an Edison power pole, which caused the transformer to fall, which
started a fire, then caused the Ushuaia Restaurant to lose power and go
without electricity for a period of time, and recommended a settlement in
the amount of $32,000.

  2  August 8, 2017
 Motion by Councilmember O’Day, seconded by Councilmember
Himmelrich, to approve Settlement Agreement No. 10529 (CCS), in the
amount of $32,000. The motion was approved by the following vote:

AYES:  Councilmembers McKeown, Vazquez, Himmelrich, O’Day
  Mayor Pro Tem Davis
NOES:  None
ABSENT: Mayor Winterer, Councilmember O’Connor

1.E. Conference with Legal Counsel – Potential Litigation:
Consideration of whether to initiate litigation pursuant to Government
Code Section 54956.9 (d)(4): 1238 10th Street LLC

The Interim City Attorney advised this matter is a receipt of money for a
20-unit apartment building, in which the ownership failed to comply with
all aspects of city law and coding, they failed to file the proper paperwork
with the appropriate agencies or give the appropriate paperwork to each of
the tenants. The City has resolved the dispute with the ownership, in which
the ownership would pay penalties in the amount of $28,000.

Motion by Councilmember McKeown, seconded by Councilmember
O’Day, to accept payment in the amount of $28,000, for settlement only
technical violations, not other issues that may have arisen from what’s
happened at the property at question. The motion was approved by the
following vote:

AYES:  Councilmembers McKeown, Vazquez, Himmelrich, O’Day,
  Mayor Pro Tem Davis
NOES: None
ABSENT: Councilmember O’Connor, Mayor Winterer

1.F. Conference with Labor Negotiator-City Negotiator: Donna C.
Peter, Director of Human Resources-Bargaining Units: California
Teamsters Local 911 (Teamsters), Fire Executive Management
Association (FEMA), and SMART-TD

The Interim City Attorney advised this matter was heard, with no
reportable action taken.

1.G. Conference with Legal Counsel – Existing Litigation: Litigation
has been initiated formally pursuant to Government Code Section
54659.(d)(1): Airbnb, Inc. and Homeaway.com, Inc. v. City of Santa

was significant enough to cast a No Vote.
